offer.text: Escort this contact to the nearest other village under the current safe-conduct terms. Payment: seven emeralds.

accept.text: The issuer and safe-conduct context are now fixed. Provider absence pauses the escort.

in_progress.text: Lead the issuer safely to the nearest other village.

ready.text: The escorted contact has reached the destination.

complete.text: The civilian escort is acknowledged. Seven emeralds are paid.
